metadata.title: 24 ITEMS Rajasthani Thali & Live Grill @ Signature Global Mall aka Food Mall of Ghaziabad/Vaishali
metadata.description:
#paidcollaboration #advertisement In today's episode we have come to check out the swanky dedicated food mall of Ghaziabad named Signature Global Food Mall. It is a huge building with a colourful facade and houses some popular names like Haldiram, BBQ, Pita Pit etc. Apart from the restaurants, it also houses a huge play area for kids. A dedicated food mall is the best place to hang out or unwind with friends or families especially when the center of such gathering is about good food. 

During our visit we had tried a kadak chai from chai thela, hakka noodles, chilli chicken and paneer tikka from Pita Pit and China Town, a 24 items based Rajasthani thali at Ghoomar, some kebab at BBQ and casatta pastry at Temptations.
